evidence.title: Vaughan Construction Update
evidence.excerpt: Microsoft reports its first Vaughan building completed on July 2, with internal and external equipment work continuing; the datacentre is not operational.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of exact content-decoded HTTP response-body bytes
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual projection and attribution only. No open redistribution licence for source documents or media is asserted. Raw HTML, PDFs, engineering plans, map tiles, aerial imagery and personal contact fields remain temporary and are not distributed.
metadata.selected_observation_basis: Explicit dated completion of the first building shell, followed by continuing equipment installations, testing and preparation in the August 5 first-party update. This is shell, not operational or completed fit-out.
metadata.successor_review: Microsoft August 5 explicitly says not yet operational, equipment work continuing through early 2028 and second building not expected to start until mid-2027. A ConstructConnect search index lists an August 21 substantial-performance certificate at 6100 Langstaff, but the full certificate was not retrievable in this bounded review; its underlying date and contract scope remain unknown. Reviewer must inspect this potential successor before admission. A building-shell completion would be consistent with the selected shell state, not proof of operational completion.
